name: Hagbeast
description: An enormous predator combining the bulk of a bear, the articulated limbs of a spider, and the armored tail and stinger of a scorpion.

abilities.name: Armored Hide
abilities.description: The Hagbeast has resistance to physical damage from attacks made beyond Very Close range.

abilities.name: Web Snare
abilities.description: Cost: 1 Stress. The target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Failure: Restrained. The target can escape with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll (14).

abilities.name: Venomous Stinger
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+3 physical damage and the target becomes Poisoned. The next time the Poisoned target marks HP, they also mark 1 Stress, then the poison ends.

abilities.name: Brood Guardian
abilities.description: When a PC within Close range attacks the Cocoon, the Hagbeast may mark a Stress to move into Melee range of that PC.
